_comment: Everything in this funnel that is a setting rather than copy. Copy is in copy.json, the form in core.mjs, the routing rules in route.mjs. Built 6 Nov 2026 for the AI visibility retainer (GEO and ChatGPT ads). Read g/uk-ai-visibility/LAUNCH.md before changing anything here. Nothing on these pages may describe commission: this is a retainer, priced on the page.
_path: The address the funnel is served at. The build checks it against the redirect and header rules in netlify.toml.
_live: True from the start (6 Nov 2026): ClickUp list, Calendly event and both Zaps were set up the same day. The ads stay paused until the owner says yes.

legal._registerCheck: As the law funnel: true only in the same change that sets COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY in production.

funnel._calendlyUrl: Event type 2b6f4168-ecb4-45a4-b565-aadb51fe96ce, owned by Sondre so that he is the host of every meeting (8 Nov 2026). The first event, f1f1d78a-9b14-435d-8de6-3472da1df542 (6 Nov 2026, organisation account), stays in Zap 2's eventTypes beside it so that a cancellation or a reschedule of a booking made on it still finds its lead.

ab._ab: A 50/50 test from 8 Nov 2026: variant b shows the ten to one module after 'Why now', variant a is the page as before. The variant is drawn per visit in the head of the page and kept in sessionStorage for the rest of the session, so /book can tell which one a lead saw. Without a script the page is variant a. ?ab=a or ?ab=b forces a variant for checking, is not stored, and is sent as forced: 1. Events, Meta custom events after Accept only: AbView, AbFormReach (the form a quarter in view), AbFormStart (first focus in the form), AbQualified (with QualifiedForm). Read the result as AbFormStart per AbView by variant. Remove this block and the module together, or make the winner the page.

clickup._comment: AI VISIBILITY - UK - Retainer (CRM folder), made 6 Nov 2026 with the statuses of the health and law lists and the shared fields (lead_id, Nettside, Email, Contact Name, Phone, Job Title, CRM Item Type, Sales Stage). Leads carry the tags ai-visibility and retainer.
